title: MINOR: Move KRaftMetadataCachePublisher to metadata module and convert to Java
body:
This PR converts `KRaftMetadataCachePublisher` from Scala to Java,
moves it to `metadata` module, and renames the class from
`KRaftMetadataCachePublisher` to `MetadataCachePublisher`.
